verifications.claim: All U.S. Costco warehouses will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'No, Costco is not open on Easter 2026. Easter Sunday is one of the seven holidays that Costco closes its U.S. warehouses.'; R2: 'Costco will be closed on Easter, which falls on Sunday, April 5, 2026.'; R3: 'Costco will not be an option... warehouses will be closed'; R4: 'COSTCO will close all of its warehouses... for Easter Sunday... April 5.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Costco U.S. warehouses are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.

verifications.claim: Costco warehouses' normal operating hours will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Normal operations are expected to continue at all of these stores on Monday, April 6.' (context: stores closing for Easter, including Costco)
verifications.reasoning: R4 explicitly states normal operations resume Monday, April 6, for Easter-closing stores like Costco.

verifications.claim: Easter is one of the seven major holidays when Costco warehouses are closed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Easter Sunday is one of the seven holidays that Costco closes its U.S. warehouses.'; R4: lists 6 holidays plus Easter (New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day).
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly confirms Easter as one of seven holidays Costco closes; R4 lists exactly seven including Easter.

verifications.claim: Walmart is open while Costco is closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Is Walmart open on Easter? Yes, Walmart stores are open...'; 'No, Costco is not open'; R2: 'Like Costco... closed on Easter, but... Walmart... will be open'; R3: Walmart under open stores, Costco closed.
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state Walmart open and Costco closed on Easter Sunday 2026.
